name: hermes_constants_resolve_reasoning_config
notes: Reasoning-effort resolution chokepoint. Per-model tolerant lookup (canonical model-name variants) runs via the LINKED real port (hermes_constants_reasoning.c); the resolve_config body is a faithful traced copy; reasoning_parse_effort is a verbatim copy of the slash_commands.c leaf parser. Inputs encoded as <model>|<cfg-json>. Covers: null/empty cfg, global effort (valid/case-insensitive/disabled-bool/True/none/bogus), derived model from string and dict model sections, per-model hits via exact, aggregator-strip, and dot/dash spelling-tolerant variants, miss falling back to global. Twin B3 branches on truthy overrides — avoid explicitly-empty overrides objects in inputs (C treats {} as present, LIVE's `or {}` makes it absent).
